question: do the recorded judged verdicts replay when the same judgement is requested again
why: the deterministic re-derivation could not reach the judged layer, so its reproducibility was unmeasured
design: 24 recorded element judgements sampled with a fixed seed, stratified across the three confidence bands, re-verified from the same retained artifacts with the same judge and the committed verifier

deterministic_cases.note: two items retrieved no candidate span, so the verifier returns not_satisfied without a model call; both replayed identically by construction and are reported separately

interpretation: the high confidence band replayed perfectly at 10 of 10, which is the band the selective evaluator admits
the band below 0.7 replayed at 0 of 4, so those verdicts carry no reproducible content and must not be scored
a disagreement cannot be attributed to judge stochasticity rather than item ambiguity from this design alone
limits: 24 judgements is a small sample and the low band contained only 5 items in total
the same judge was used, so this measures replay, not cross-model agreement
no human label exists for any of these items, so this says nothing about correctness
claim_scope: judged-layer reproducibility evidence only; no treatment effect is claimed
